audit_items.proof_trace: `mint_ctokens` computes `float::int_div(collateral_amount, exchange_rate)` which evaluates to `WAD * collateral_amount / exchange_rate.value`; since `exchange_rate.value = exchange_rate_decimal * WAD` this simplifies to `floor(collateral_amount / exchange_rate_decimal)` via u256 truncation-toward-zero. Grep confirms `increase_ctoken_supply` has a single caller (`mint_ctokens`) and no alternative cToken-minting path exists, so the property holds unconditionally.
